title: RSA Archer Security Analyst 2
description:
Job Title: RSA Archer Security Analyst 2
Job Location: Austin, TX (Onsite)
Description:
AgreeYa is a global Systems Integrator and is seeking an experienced Network Security Analyst to join our growing team.
Required Certifications
Must Have:
Archer Certified Professional (ACP)  OR Level 3 Archer Certified Administrator – Expert Certification

Essential Duties and Responsibilities
  • Design, implement, configure, and maintain RSA Archer solutions, with emphasis on:
    • Assessment & Authorization (A&A)
    • Controls Assurance Program Management
    • Issues Management
    • Custom Archer applications
    • System integrations
    • Perform detailed business and functional requirements gathering and analysis; translate requirements into:
    • Solution designs
    • Configuration specifications
    • User stories
    • Implementation plans
  • Configure and customize Archer applications including:
    • Questionnaires and surveys
    • Forms and data fields
    • Workflows and approvals
    • Calculations and data relationships
    • Access controls and role-based permissions
    • Data feeds and automated imports
  • Develop and integrate RESTful and web services to enable API connectivity between Archer and external enterprise systems (e.g., ServiceNow or other ITSM, CMDB, or risk platforms).
  • Implement client-side logic, validations, and dynamic behaviors using JavaScript and jQuery within Archer applications.
  • Produce and maintain technical documentation covering:
    • System design and configuration
    • Integration specifications
    • Testing plans and results
    • Change requests and deviations
    • Process transformation artifacts
    • Project management documentation using standard templates
  • Utilize project management and tracking tools to monitor development progress, deliverables, risks, and milestones.
  • Follow established change management, release management, and governance processes for all deployments to production environments.
  • Provide troubleshooting, defect resolution, and performance optimization for Archer applications.
  • Support end-user adoption through knowledge transfer, training materials, and solution walkthroughs.
  • Perform related duties and special projects as assigned.
Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
  • Expert knowledge of RSA Archer platform architecture, data model, application configuration, and workflow design
  • Strong understanding of GRC processes, risk management, compliance frameworks, and security control assurance
  • Experience integrating Archer with external enterprise platforms using REST APIs and web services
  • Proficiency in JavaScript/jQuery for client-side customizations
  • Ability to translate complex business requirements into technical configurations
  • Strong documentation and communication skills
  • Experience working in structured change-controlled environments
  • Ability to work independently on complex technical implementations
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience supporting large enterprise or government GRC implementations
  • Familiarity with security frameworks such as NIST, ISO 27001, SOC, or regulatory compliance programs
  • Experience integrating Archer with ServiceNow or similar ITSM platforms
  • Prior work in information security, risk, or compliance teams
 
Work Environment
  • Works independently and collaboratively in cross-functional teams
  • Engages with security, risk, compliance, IT, and business stakeholders
  • Supports mission-critical enterprise GRC operations
Education Required:
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience

title: L1 Operation Support Engineer
description:
Job Title ::              Operation Support Engineer 
Job Location ::       Phoenix AZ (Onsite)
Shift time ::            2 PM to 11 PM Phoenix Time
 
Description:

  Escalate issues to Level 2/3 teams as needed, following escalation protocols.

  Execute routine server maintenance tasks (log rotation, script executions, etc.) as per SOPs.
  Assist in patch management and server reboots during maintenance windows.
  Maintain awareness of ongoing issues, scheduled maintenance, and outages.
Education Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

title: Active Directory (AD) / Microsoft Exchange  Engineer
description:
Job Title ::              Active Directory (AD) / Microsoft Exchange Engineer
Job Location ::       Phoenix AZ (Onsite)
Shift time ::            06:00 AM to 03:00 PM
 
Description:
 
AgreeYa is a global Systems Integrator and is seeking an Active Directory (AD) / Microsoft Exchange Engineer to join our growing team. We are looking for an Active Directory (AD) / Microsoft Exchange Engineer with strong experience as Windows System Administrator, with at least 5 years focused on AD and Exchange.
 
Job Responsibilities
 
Active Directory (AD) / Microsoft Exchange:

  • Administer and maintain Active Directory and EntraID
  • Experience Group Policy Objects (GPOs) and security and compliance.
  • Experience in migrations, upgrades, and domain consolidations.
  • Experience Troubleshoot and resolve authentication, replication, and trust issues.
  • Experience Manage DNS, DHCP, and other AD-integrated services.
  • Experience in managing and support Microsoft Exchange environments (on-prem, hybrid, and/or Exchange Online)
  • Experience with Exchange Online, hybrid Exchange deployments, and mail flow routing
  • Knowledge of email security best practices, including SPF, DKIM, DMARC, and anti-spam/anti-malware policies.
  • Administer, configure, and maintain Proofpoint Email Protection, TAP, Threat Response Auto Pull (TRAP), DLP, and Encryption
  • Support and maintain Windows Server (2016/2019/2022) infrastructure.
  • Familiarity with Windows Failover Clustering, DFS, and storage replication.
  • Monitor server performance, patching, and system health.
  • Automate tasks and reporting via PowerShell and other scripting tools.
  • Familiar with auditing, logging, and privileged access controls
 
Required Qualifications:
  • 7+ years of experience as a Windows System Administrator, with at least 5 years focused on AD and Exchange.
  • Strong knowledge of Active Directory architecture and managing Exchange online
  • Deep understanding of Exchange Server 2016/2019 and/or Office 365 (Exchange Online).
  • PowerShell scripting experience.
  • Familiarity with Azure AD, ADFS, and hybrid identity setups.
  • Experience with Microsoft 365 services and administration.
 
Certifications:
  • Microsoft certifications: MCSE, Windows Server Hybrid Administrator Associate, Identity and Access Administrator Associate
  • Microsoft 365 Certified: Administrator Expert
 
Soft Skills:
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
  • Excellent communication and documentation skills.
  • Ability to lead small infrastructure projects and mentor junior team members.
  • Proactive, self-motivated, and able to work independently or as part of a team.

title: Information Security Analyst - I
description:
Job Title ::              SOC Analyst
 Location ::       Remote / Home Based

AgreeYa is a global Systems Integrator and is seeking an experienced , SOC Analyst to join our growing team. Join our dynamic team as a SOC Analyst where you play a pivotal role in the Security Incident and Event Management (SIEM) workflow, serving as the 24x7 "eyes on glass" who monitor alerts and escalate incidents as necessary. 
  
JOB DUTIES: 
Information Security Analysts are the backbone of the Security Operations Center (SOC), providing crucial support to enterprise-level customers.
Tier-1 Security Analysts with at least one year of experience in security or technical troubleshooting roles, such as help desk, handle various tasks across various platforms.
They play a pivotal role in the Security Incident and Event Management (SIEM) workflow, serving as the 24x7 "eyes on glass" who monitor alerts and escalate incidents as necessary. 
 
Responsibilities:  -

  • Conduct near real-time security monitoring in a 24x7 environment, utilizing proprietary SIEM and cybersecurity tools to identify Indicators of Compromise (IOCs).
  • Monitor alert health in near real-time and escalate critical alerts according to service level agreements.
  • Detects and analyzes security incidents, particularly complex or escalated events, to assess threats effectively.
  • Address customer Requests For Information, leveraging soft and technical skills to query raw logs for IOCs, provide insights into SOC infrastructure, and offer guidance on SIEM features and best practices.
  • Perform level 1 assessment of incoming alerts, prioritizing and correlating details to determine severity within the customer environment and coordinating with tier II/III for critical incidents as needed.
  • Execute basic incident response activities using customer SIEM and cybersecurity toolkits.
  • Contribute to the SOC Knowledge Base and provide input for revisions. -Draft clear and concise escalation tickets. 
 
MUST-HAVE SKILLS: 
  • Associate degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field.
  • 1 to 3 years of experience in a security-related role.
  • Fundamental knowledge of Cyber Security technologies.
  • Understanding of the threat landscape and indicators of compromise. -Strong problem-solving skills.
  • Proactively engage with customers, client executives, and management teams.
  • Excellent documentation and communication abilities in written and oral English. 
 
DESIRED SKILLS: 
  • Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field.
  • One or more years of experience in an Information Security Analyst position.
  • Familiarity with basic cyber threat hunting techniques.
  • Experience in incident response using different SIEMs and adhering to industry best practices.
  • Proficiency in investigating security incidents, developing/tuning use cases, and understanding incident response protocols.
  • Ability to create new content, searches, and scripts for tools like Splunk, QRadar, Sentinel, etc. -Understanding of device logging, network troubleshooting, and device troubleshooting.
  • Experience with incident response techniques such as network forensic analysis.
  • Familiarity with Intrusion Prevention Systems (IPS) and analyzing alerts generated by inspection.
  • Scripting knowledge in languages like Python, PowerShell, Bash Shell, Java, Ansible, etc.
  • Relevant security certifications such as SANS GIAC, GCIH, CompTIA Security+, CCNP-Security, CySA+, GCED, CEH, or similar credentials.
